segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the renewal before your current term ends on June 30 and make sure the seat count is right for the July invoice.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Sure. We’re at 64 seats today, but finance only wants to renew 58. Six contractors roll off in mid-June.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Got it, 58 seats starting July 1. Same business tier and the reporting add-on, correct?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yes, keep the reporting add-on. The only thing I need confirmed is whether the invoice can be annual again, net 30, billed to the Chicago office.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yes. Annual invoice, net 30, Chicago billing address. At 58 seats, the total is $41,760 for the year, plus the reporting add-on at $6,000, so $47,760 before tax.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay, that matches what I had. Can you include the service language from last year? Our legal team asked not to reopen the standard terms unless something changed.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Nothing changed on the standard terms. I can send the renewal order form this afternoon with the same terms referenced and the July 1 through June 30 dates.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. If you send it by 3:00 Eastern, I can get it into our approval packet for tomorrow morning.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. And for go-live, since this is a continuation, there’s no deployment work. I’ll note the seat reduction effective July 1 so access stays active for the 58 named users.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy accounts payable. Once it’s signed, we’ll issue the PO. It should be PO-7814, but I’ll confirm on our side.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Sounds good. I’ll send the order form and pricing summary today, and you can reply with the PO when it’s ready.
